name: Exarch Kraglen

abilities.name: Swipe
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Slaughter
abilities.description: Exarch Kraglen winds up and eviscerates his targets with his claws, hitting twice for major physical damage. This can be blocked. If not, it will one-shot most non-tanks.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Exarch Kraglen glows red and charges at a target, dealing major physical damage. This ability needs to be blocked, and is similar to Xal-Nur the Slaver's charge in the Ruins of Mazzatun in that regard.

abilities.name: Blood Rage
abilities.description: Exarch Kraglen roars loudly, knocking back anyone in melee range, and will then continue on, draining the affected target's resources until he is interrupted. Those fighting from a distance can use Crushing Shock or Venom Arrow to interrupt this ability to help out the tank. This is the most crucial mechanic to pay attention to.

abilities.name: Fault Line
abilities.description: Exarch Kraglen smashes the ground with his fists, indicated by a massive red circle, dealing very high physical damage and knocking down targets. Afterward, fissures crack open the ground in a winding line towards targets, indicated by additional smaller red circles, dealing moderate physical damage and stunning each. On Veteran, if you're in range when he stomps, it may be a one-shot ability.

abilities.name: Fracture
abilities.description: Small line AoEs that link between the fissures created by "Fault Line", which deal moderate physical damage.

hardmode_info: Hard Mode can only be activated on Veteran.

notes: Exarch Kraglen was previously mentioned in My Beloved Siblings, the Exarchs, a book that could be found in Greymoor content prior to Stone Garden being released.
related_quests: Method and Madness: Disrupt the vile lycanthropic experiments being conducted deep beneath Skyrim.
Pledge: Stone Garden: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Stone Garden.
The Gray Council: Explore the secrets of Grayhome.
summary: Exarch Kraglen is a Nord werewolf behemoth and a high-ranking member of the Gray Host who can be found in the Stone Garden. He is the dungeon's first boss, where he guards the entrance to Arkasis's laboratory.
